mainEntity.name: Do I need an accountant if I already have a bookkeeper?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bookkeeper records transactions; an accountant gives structural, tax, and strategic advice and lodges returns. Most small businesses benefit from both — and many firms offer both under one roof. In the questionnaire, tell us what you already have and what you need added, and we will match the gap.

mainEntity.name: When should a small business get an accountant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideally before you start — structure decisions made at launch affect tax for years. But even established businesses benefit when revenue grows, staff are added, you are considering property, or you feel your current accountant is reactive rather than proactive. Matching is free, so there is no downside to exploring a better fit.

mainEntity.name: How much does a small business accountant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most small businesses spend $400–$1,000 per month for ongoing accounting and compliance, though this varies widely with complexity. Project work (structuring, forecasting, setup) is typically quoted separately. The matched firm gives you a clear quote — the matching service is free to you.

mainEntity.name: Can a small business accountant help with cash-flow forecasting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many matched firms offer cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and management reporting alongside compliance. Tell us in the questionnaire whether you want forward-looking advisory as well as returns and BAS, and we will match you with a firm that offers both.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched small business accountant contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your business needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a small business accountant help with Payday Super?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. From 1 July 2026, Payday Super requires super contributions alongside each payday. The matched firm ensures your payroll system is ready and compliant, so you avoid director penalty notices for late super.

mainEntity.name: Is small business accountant matching free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can a small business accountant help me switch software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched firm manages cloud accounting migrations — bringing across opening balances, customer and supplier records, and historical transactions, then reconciling so your new system is correct from day one. Tell us in the questionnaire if you need a software migration.

blocks.heading: Small Business Accountant — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKSmall Business Accountant — what we can help withAn accountant who gets your business stageA startup has different needs to a mature trading business. A side hustle has different needs to a company with 20 staff. Our matching identifies your stage — launch, growth, maturity, or exit — and connects you with a firm experienced in that phase. You get proactive advice relevant to where you are, not generic annual-compliance-only service.Services beyond the tax returnThe right small business accountant does more than lodge returns. They help with structure (sole trader vs company vs trust), cash-flow forecasting, pricing strategy, payroll, STP2, super guarantee compliance, BAS timing, and board-level reporting. Tell us which of these you need in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that genuinely offers them.Scaling with youAs your business grows, your accounting needs change — you may need forward-looking advisory, a board pack, or a transition to accrual accounting. Our matched firms support businesses through these transitions, so you are not hunting for a new accountant every two years. One match, an ongoing relationship that grows with you.
